definition: To develop a risk profile, the organization determines the relationship between the level of performance for a strategy or business objective and the expected amount of risk. On a risk graph, performance is plotted along the x-axis and risk is along the y-axis (Figure D.1). The resulting line is often referred to as a “risk curve” or “risk profile.”
